_readme: A COLD PLACE WITH NO SCENE KEY (stage 2 of one water on the tree, WATER_V2.md 14.4). The scene holds the eye's start
and its views, and the clocks of the bar scene (scene/SceneClocks.h) so every run is the same water. Nothing here
names a place, a box, a station or a solver: the solver stands about the eye's start on the global lattice
(water.swe.windowTiles), its bed is the one height stack at whatever level the stack holds there, its open sea
the tide atlas, its tide focus the station its window holds. What the tree holds here is what it holds.
